title: Filter a numeric range
summary: A range query selects numbers between bounds.
introduction: A range query selects numbers between bounds. Your task: Change the upper bound to 50.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for filter a numeric range

blocks.text: A range query selects numbers between bounds. gte means greater than or equal to, and lte means less than or equal to.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: A range query applies numeric or date bounds, such as gte for greater than or equal to.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Choose a numeric mapping for numeric comparisons. A text page count can behave differently.
